entities.summary: Jacob Mark "Jake" Pitts is an American musician best known as the lead guitarist and occasional backing vocalist of the rock band Black Veil Brides. Pitts and fellow Black Veil Brides guitarist Jinxx won Revolver Magazine's Golden Gods Award for "Best Guitarists 2012".
